==Experience and harvesting==
[[File:Harvesting herbiboar.gif|thumb|200px|right|A player harvests the herbs from a herbiboar.]]
An inspection of the herbiboar's trail can grant 50 experience and occasionally gives [[numulite]] or [[unidentified fossils]]. Once the player attacks the tunnel at the end of a trail, a herbiboar appears and [[Hunter]] experience is gained depending on the player's Hunter level. After the herbiboar appears, it can be harvested, requiring at least level 31 [[Herblore]].

Experience gained from attacking the tunnel at the end of a trail scales depending on the base Hunter level (without considering boosts) of the player. The base value granted is 1,950 experience at level 80 Hunter, with 30 additional experience gained per Hunter level above 80 until level 94. Strangely, 15 additional experience is granted per Hunter level at level 95, instead of the normal 30 additional experience. Afterwards, 19 additional experience is gained per level from 95 to 99 Hunter.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/966235023061012480|date=21 February 2018|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/99549|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=Looking closer, that formula goes up to 95, At 95, it's 2385, then 2404, then 2423, etc. adding 19 per level up to 99. I don't know why.}}

Harvesting from the herbiboar earns the player experience, herbs, and a chance to obtain the pet [[Herbi]]. The amount of herbs picked is a random number 1–3, and can be increased to 2–4 if [[magic secateurs]] are equipped or held in the player's inventory. For each herb picked except for the first, 25 Herblore experience is granted. 

An average of 59–66 herbiboars can be caught per hour while using [[stamina potion]]s. This makes the experience rates at level 80 somewhere in between 115,000–128,000, only increasing as Hunter level increases. A considerably lower number will be caught per hour if not using stamina potions, due to the amount of running required. A weight of 0 kg or lower is highly recommended, as well as the [[herb sack]]. Since fossils weigh a bit, it is recommended to store them occasionally in the storage box by the [[mycelium pool]].

Boosting with [[super hunter potion]]s allows for hunting the herbiboar from level 74.
